method: non-generative extraction and color/alpha separation from full-face reference
brow_cleanup: Reference outlines traced to remove intersecting hair lines
blush_separation: Reference red/green difference converted into translucent blush, retaining diagonal strokes and removing the reference nose dot
eye_adjustment: Reference upper lash profile fit; existing iris and highlights narrowed and moved together sideways
lower_lid: existing relaxed lower line fitted to sclera boundary; redundant lower skin hidden only in embarrassed
nose_cleanup: reference nose ink replaced with surrounding blush alpha; original model nose retained
